item.title: 'Safety is our priority': Frontier schools to get security upgrades, as SHIELD project passes vote
item.description: Over the past several years, the Frontier Central School District has been working to boost security. The SHIELD project passed on January 20, starting the next phase of that work.

item.title: 'A nice smooth trail to ride on': Chautauqua Lake Snowmobile Club volunteers groom trails for winter fun
item.description: Behind the perfectly groomed trails around Mayville are dedicated volunteers like Jason Carr, chairman of the board of the Chautauqua Lake Snowmobile Club.

item.title: 'It was not a good job': Residents in Black Rock and Riverside not happy with snow clean-up
item.description: Several Buffalo neighborhoods remain unplowed days after a major snowstorm, with residents in the Black Rock and Riverside areas expressing frustration about the city's snow removal efforts.

item.title: 'I can't live like this': Residents continue to speak out on Buffalo public housing issues
item.description: Residents at Buffalo Municipal Housing Authority properties continue to speak out about ongoing maintenance issues that have persisted for months.
